notes.title: Playtest Version 3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Playtest Version 3.0[/h1]

[h2]Major Gameplay Update[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Free-Form Movement[/b]: Movement in battle has transitioned from grid-based to free-form, offering a more fluid and dynamic tactical experience. Note: Attacks, enemy placement, and magic remain grid-based for now.
[*][b]Auto-Wait Functionality[/b]: Characters will now automatically wait when they run out of both movement and actions, streamlining turn flow.
[/list]

[h2]UI and UX Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Menu Pacing Enhancements[/b]: Improved menu behavior to maintain better pacing during battle and decision-making phases.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various bugs have been resolved to improve overall game stability and gameplay consistency.
[/list]

We're excited to bring you this major evolution in the battle system! As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable. Let us know what you think of Playtest Version 3.0!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.6
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.6[/h1]

[h2]Visual and UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Animation Updates[/b]: Smoothed and improved transitions for all animations, making gameplay more fluid and immersive.
[*][b]Font Update[/b]: Refreshed in-game fonts for better readability and a cleaner look.
[*][b]Damage Indicator Redesign[/b]: Redesigned the damage indicator when selecting a target to make combat feedback clearer.
[*][b]Tutorial Glyph Updates[/b]: Updated glyphs shown in tutorials to work better with mouse and keyboard setups.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Default Mouse Control Remapping[/b]: Remapped default mouse controls to be more intuitive and user-friendly during gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where pausing the game during a tutorial could cause the tutorial to break.
[*]Resolved unintended behavior when clicking other menu options during move, attack, or magic selection phases in battle.
[/list]

Your feedback is incredibly helpful as we continue refining the game experience. Thank you for testing Playtest Version 2.6!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.5
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.5[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Blocking Mechanic[/b]: Introduced a new blocking mechanic where players or enemies can block an attack by pressing the same button as the attacker within a very tight timeframe, determined by the Physical Evasion stat. Note: The mechanic is still in progress, and animations for blocking are being smoothed out.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse and Keyboard Controls[/b]: Improved functionality for smoother and more responsive input handling.
[*][b]Glyph Updates[/b]: Enhanced glyphs for mouse and keyboard controls for better visual clarity and consistency.
[*][b]Animation Updates[/b]: Smoothed animations across the game for a more polished and immersive experience.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Resolved an issue where character positions could reset unexpectedly.
[*]Improved the registration of characters in the battle start area for more reliable setup.
[*]Updated spell markers to ensure they function correctly.
[/list]

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some spell markers remain visible after a character dies.
[*]Enemies occasionally stop pursuing players on certain squares.
[*]Enemy stats are not fully displayed at wave start.
[*]Warcart pictures need to update based on the character using it.
[/list]

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Spell Tree[/b]: A system for progressively learning new spells.
[*][b]Title Unlock System[/b]: Unlock and collect titles to show off your achievements.
[/list]

Thank you for testing Playtest Version 2.5! Your feedback helps us improve the game. Let us know what you think of these changes!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.4
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.4[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Battle Mechanic[/b]: Introduced a new melee fighting system that displays on-screen possible combo buttons and provides real-time feedback during combat, adding depth and strategy to melee encounters.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336900/a53622d3a483d05c8bb4d708755cd1e1e96b410d.png[/img]
[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Smoothed Battle Animations[/b]: Refined and polished battle animations for a more fluid and immersive combat experience.
[*][b]Unique Weapon Animations[/b]: Created distinct animations for each weapon type, adding variety and personality to combat styles.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Spells[/b]: Resolved various issues with spell casting and effects to ensure consistent functionality.
[*][b]Elemental Map[/b]: Fixed bugs related to the elemental map for more accurate and intuitive gameplay.
[*][b]Weather Effects[/b]: Corrected visual and functional bugs affecting weather systems for improved immersion.
[*][b]Interactions[/b]: Addressed interaction-related bugs to enhance gameplay reliability and smoothness.
[/list]

We value your feedback! Let us know your thoughts on the new features and improvements in Playtest Version 2.4. Thank you for testing and helping us refine the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.2
notes.content:

Your input is invaluable! Let us know what you think of these updates as we refine the game further. Thank you for testing Playtest Version 2.2!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest v2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Playtest v2.1[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Spell Status Bug[/b]: Resolved an issue where spells that result in physical attacks incorrectly applied statuses.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest V2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Playtest v2.0[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Characters[/b]: Added 7 new characters to the roster, expanding your tactical options and team-building possibilities.  4 new enemies and 3 new allies.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Battle System Enhancements[/b]: Smoothed out animations and mechanics for attacking, casting spells, movement, and nearly every aspect of combat for a more fluid experience.
[*][b]Spell and Attack Rebalancing[/b]: Rebalanced spells and attacks to improve gameplay dynamics. Try out Rod spells to see some major changes!
[/list]

[h2]Visual Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Shader Reworks[/b]: Reworked sky and character shaders to improve visual fidelity and create a more immersive atmosphere.
[/list]

[h2]Tutorial Expansion[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial Updates[/b]: Expanded the tutorial to cover more gameplay mechanics and improve player onboarding.
[/list]

Your feedback is crucial! Let us know your thoughts and suggestions as you explore the exciting updates in Playtest v2.0. Thank you for testing!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest v1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Playtest v1.3[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Basic Mouse and Keyboard Support[/b]: Introduced foundational support for mouse and keyboard input, enhancing accessibility and control options.
[*][b]Rotating Quests[/b]: Added rotating quests to track Wave targets, bringing dynamic objectives to gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Character Stats Page[/b]: Updated the War Cart’s character stats page to include a preview of equipped items, giving players better insight into their loadout.
[*][b]Main Menu Enhancements[/b]: Expanded the main menu with the following additions:

Control Options

More feedback submission options

A Quit button for quicker exits
[/list]

[h2]Tutorial Expansion[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial Updates[/b]: The tutorial has been expanded to cover more gameplay mechanics. This is still a work in progress, and further iterations will follow.
[/list]

We value your feedback! Please share any bugs or suggestions to help us refine Playtest v1.3. Thank you for participating!

notes.title: Patch Notes: December 15, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: December 15, 2024[/h1]

[h2]New Additions[/h2]

We appreciate your continued feedback and support. Please report any bugs or suggestions to our Discord or community page.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest v1.2

[/list]

We value your feedback! Please report any bugs or suggestions to our Discord (link in Library). Thank you for playtesting!
